title: Hero wordmark that becomes the header logo, with an easing nav underline
summary: One fixed link laid out in the header slot and transformed onto the hero's reference box, unwinding to identity over 60 % of the hero (cubic in-out); the nav underline eases both edges at 1 − e^(−10·dt) and snaps the last .05 px; reduced motion keeps the link docked and fades a decorative hero copy
variants: Vanilla transform on the shared ticker (this)
GSAP: one ScrollTrigger scrub on the hero with the same from-transform measured on refresh
CSS scroll-driven animation: animation-timeline: view() on the hero, with the from-transform written into custom properties on resize
